body:
次の内容で GIF を作成して: 踊らせる、喜びの舞

【制作適応：今回の出力】上記は動きの意図です。この呼び出しではGIFファイルではなく、横4列×縦2行、合計8コマの単一PNGスプライトシートだけを描いてください。左上から右へ、次に下の段へ進む順序。各コマは同じ正方形で、区切り線、余白、番号、時刻、文字は不要。固定カメラ、固定の大きさと地面線、十分な余白、コマ間でキャラクターの同一性を維持し、実際に異なる連続動作を描く。純白背景。後で各コマを切り出してGIFにします。
8コマで左右のステップ、腕を上げる、体をひねる、小さく跳ぶ、着地、元の姿勢。全身と足元をすべてのコマに収める。

en.description: 9 frames, 1.2 seconds, 443×443px; repeats indefinitely. GPT Image frame-sheet + local GIF encoding.
en.body:
## How to use

Upload the 1 project-generated reference image(s) in the displayed order (R17), then use the complete adapted prompt.

Reuse the archived GPT Image sheet and resample its action to nine frames. Sources with eight poses split one held pose across two encoded frames without adding a new pose; longer sequences select nine chronological poses. Preserve total duration and loop settings. Small source cells are enlarged for display without adding detail. The GIF is composed locally; the image tool returned a still PNG. The source sheet, exact crops, frame delays and first-frame poster are retained in the campaign archive.

## Result and limitations

9 frames, 1.2 seconds, 443×443px; repeats indefinitely. GPT Image frame-sheet + local GIF encoding.

Reviewed all nine-frame sequences in four contact sheets: action order, identity, captions and final poses retained. This output reuses archived GPT Image source pixels; no new provider call. One held pose is split into two frames; eight distinct source poses, nine encoded frames. Total duration and playback count preserved. Original source review (frame counts describe source only): Eight poses show side steps, arm lift, jump, landing and return. Full body fits each cell. Small scale and ground-line variations remain visible.

## Source

Adapted by Prompt Seen from [@thibi_nanashi's original prompt](https://x.com/thibi_nanashi/status/2118136361584877622). The author labels the source work Image 2.6; this run only establishes the GPT Image family, with no exact model ID. The prompt preserves its submitted language on both page editions. Likes describe the whole source post, shared by variants, and are not engagement for this example.

zh-Hans.body:
## 使用方法

按显示顺序上传 1 张本站生成的参考图（R17），使用完整改编词。

复用已生成的 GPT Image 精灵图，统一合成 9 帧：8 姿态素材将一次停留拆成两个编码帧，不新增姿态，较长序列按顺序选取 9 帧。保留总时长与循环设置，小尺寸素材仅放大显示，不增加细节。生图工具返回静态 PNG；GIF 由本地合成。原精灵图、裁切坐标、逐帧时长与首帧封面均保存在批次档案。

## 结果与限制

9 帧，1.2 秒，443×443 像素，无限循环；GPT Image 精灵图逐格裁切并在本地编码为 GIF。

原始素材审核说明（以下帧数和尺寸指原始版本；当前交付统一为 9 帧）：8 帧侧步、举臂、跳跃与落地，人物完整入镜；大小和地面线略有变化。

## 来源

由 Prompt Seen 根据 [@thibi_nanashi 的原词](https://x.com/thibi_nanashi/status/2118136361584877622)改编。来源作者称原作品使用 Image 2.6；本次仅确认 GPT Image 家族，精确型号未知。中英文页面保留同一实际提交正文。点赞属于整篇来源帖，同帖变体共享统计对象，不属于本站新作品。
